thread:
maria: Heads-up — seeing sporadic 95/99th tail latency spikes from the continuous-batcher since the kernel-selector deploy around 03:12 UTC. Throughput steady but tails are 3-5x higher. Dumping perf profiles now. Anyone already looking?

kevin: On it. Spawning a few perf runs against canary. Initial hypothesis: adaptive admission/batching heuristics combined with new kernel probe path is fragmenting microbatches.

ryan: I added a lightweight 'probe' pass to prefer fused kernels when beneficial last night (rev d3f2). The probe samples latency for a 1-step KV-prefetch path and then marks kernel preference. Could be influencing admission sizing if cost model reads probe stats.

maria: Got traces — KV cache eviction rate spikes line up exactly with tail spikes. Sample from pprof: 
```
# top callstacks during spike
0x7fabc... runtime/kernel_select_probe
0x7fabc... admission/compute_microbatch_size
0x7fabc... kvcache/evict
0x7fabc... continuous_batcher/process_request
```
Also seeing lots of short-lived microbatches (batch size 1-3) in the same intervals.

monitoring-bot: ALERT: continuous-batcher tail_latency_p95 > 1200ms (baseline 230ms) for 3 mins on pool-gpu-small.

sophia: Quick experiment — I pinned a small canary pool to the legacy kernel selection (probe disabled) and tail metrics dropped back to baseline within 2 minutes. So rollback looks promising for mitigation.

kevin: Thanks. Rolling a canary rollback (deploy 1729001300 rollback-kernel-probe) to 2 nodes now. Also adding a KV eviction rate metric and a microbatch size distribution histogram to the dashboard.

deploy-bot: roll out started: rollback-kernel-probe -> pool-gpu-small (2/2 nodes)

maria: Action items: 1) Finish canary rollback fully (kevin). 2) Add KV eviction alert (sophia + kevin). 3) Add a perf regression test that exercises many short prefix sequences to ensure probe doesn't bias admission (maria). 4) Postmortem stub and follow-up to revisit the probe's telemetry semantics (owner: maria). ETA for full rollback + metrics: ~2h.

kevin: 👍 will follow up with PR to gate the probe behind a runtime flag and add a telemetry shim so probe stats don't feed the admission estimator directly. Drafting perf test now.

ryan: Sorry — my bad on the probe semantics. I'll hold any further kernel-selector changes until we add a safe shadowing mode and the perf tests pass.

maria: Good catch, thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the live incident log — will update with rollback completion and perf diffs.

kevin: rollback finished on pool-gpu-small, tail_latency_p95 back to ~240ms. Pushed metric dashboards and opened PR #2483 for probe toggle + telemetry shim.

maria: Verified. Closing immediate incident; keeping follow-ups on a tracking ticket.

sophia: Recommended follow-ups: - Add end-to-end synthetic that targets short-seq KV-heavy patterns - Make admission estimator use windowed median not instantaneous probe samples - Run canary perf for 24h before enabling probe globally

maria: Copy. Creating ticket: ENG-RUNTIME-512 (kernel-probe regression follow-ups).

kevin: I'll assign myself for the toggle + dashboard work, aiming to merge today.

maria: Thanks — great cross-team response. :thumbsup:
